title: Capsule page input (C01)
description: One main capsule (S01–S18) and its companion cut brief, as printed by docs/build.mjs (lib/capsule.mjs). A file holds either an array of capsules or {"capsules": [...]}. The same object can be written as YAML inside a ::: capsule block. Markdown is allowed in every text field. The build checks the rules marked (build) and prints warnings; it does not rewrite anything. Field names follow .orchestration/contracts/asset-manifest.md where they overlap.

id.description: Plan inventory ID (05 §2): S01–S18. (build) warns otherwise unless sample is true.

sample.description: true for a layout sample; prints a [layout sample] tag.

format.description: Kicker above the title. Default 'Main capsule'. E.g. 'Main capsule · Instagram Reel'.

title.description: The opening line / core question, in both languages. (build) warns if either is missing.

angle.description: The useful point the capsule resolves (05 §2 column 3).

duration.description: Target, e.g. '45–75 s', or {target, measured}. 'measured' only after an actual read-through. The page also prints an estimate from the word count at the front matter's wpm (default 150); (build) warns outside 45–75 s.

owner.description: Agent role or person maintaining it, e.g. 'A5'.

script.description: The spoken script. Natural Quebec French, not a sentence-for-sentence translation. Stage directions in *(italics)*.

on_screen.description: On-screen wording, one item per card, in both languages.

shot.description: Shot, props and ink cue. No photo, portrait, voice or likeness of Bill until rights and consent exist (HB-22, G4).

ink.description: Drawing name(s) from public/ink/ shown as a thumbnail beside the shot cue.

offer.description: One CTA per capsule (05 §2; asset-manifest cta). Labels follow the frozen offer matrix.

en.description: Optional CTA wording (caption or end card) if it differs from the script's last line.

note.description: Gating note, printed in the compliance box (e.g. 'no approved edition yet').

format.description: e.g. one-question exercise, fictional poll with disclosed answer, prop demonstration, corrected misconception, event invitation (05 §2).

method.description: fetched = page retrieved and read; snippet-only = search summary, printed [unverified]; project-file = a file in this repository.

factual_claims.description: false = the script states no fact that needs a source (reviewer confirms). (build) warns when sources is empty and this is not false.

credential_claims.description: true if the capsule states a designation, affiliation, experience or service scope: prints [needs G1]. Those claims are pending (G1).

compliance.description: What was checked and what must not be said.

script.description: Markdown with paragraphs separated by blank lines, or an array of beats (strings or {at, text}).
